LEMMA 1 (PROVED, green): tPowExpTailBound (a t : ℝ) (ha : 0 <= a) (ht : 2a <= t) : t^a e^{-t} <= (2a)^a e^{-a} e^{-t/2}. Proof: case a = 0 is separate (0^0 = 1 via Real.rpow_zero, and e^{-t} <= e^{-t/2} for t >= 0 via exp monotonicity); case a > 0: set u = t/(2a) >= 1, apply Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (log u <= u - 1), multiply by a > 0 to get a*log(t/(2a)) <= t/2 - a (via gcongr + field_simp), rewrite log(t/(2a)) = log t - log(2a) (Real.log_div), rearrange to a*log t - t <= a*log(2a) - a - t/2 (calc + linarith), and exponentiate: both sides are rewritten to exponential form via Real.rpow_def_of_pos (x^y = exp(y*log x)) + exp_add, then Real.exp_le_exp.mpr.

LEMMA 2 (PROVED, green): cGammaLeRealGammaRe {z : ℂ} (hz : 0 < z.re) : ||Gamma z|| <= Gamma(z.re). Proof: (i) Complex.Gamma_eq_integral hz : Gamma z = GammaIntegral z, and the exposed def Complex.GammaIntegral z = ∫ x in Ioi 0, (e^{-x} : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)^(z-1); (ii) MeasureTheory.norm_integral_le_integral_norm (Bochner/Basic.lean:934 - the BOCHNER version, NOT the SimpleFunc version of the same name in Bochner/L1.lean!) with (f := fun x => ...) (μ := volume.restrict (Ioi 0)) gives ||∫ f|| <= ∫ ||f||; (iii) the pointwise identity ||e^{-x} (x:ℂ)^(z-1)|| = e^{-x} x^{z.re-1} for x > 0: norm_mul + RCLike.norm_ofReal (as a PROOF TERM, then abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)) for the exp factor, and for the cpow factor: Complex.cpow_def_of_ne_zero (x ≠ 0), Complex.ofReal_log (h : 0 <= x) : (Real.log x : ℂ) = Complex.log (x : ℂ) (use .symm!), Complex.norm_exp (||exp w|| = e^{w.re}), the real-part computation ((log x : ℂ)*(z-1)).re = (log x)*(z.re - 1) via simp [Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.mul_re] + rwa [(z-1 : ℂ).re = z.re - 1], and Real.rpow_def_of_pos to close exp((z.re-1)*log x) = x^(z.re-1); (iv) the a.e. integral equality ∫_{Ioi 0} ||f|| = ∫_{Ioi 0} e^{-x}x^{z.re-1} via MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae (f := norm integrand) (g := real integrand) (μ := volume.restrict (Ioi 0)) ((ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ioi).mpr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x hx => hnorm x hx))) - the a.e. statement under the RESTRICTED measure is proved by ae_restrict_iff' which converts it to ∀ᵐ x ∂volume, x ∈ Ioi 0 -> f x = g x, satisfied by the pointwise fact; (v) Real.Gamma_eq_integral (hs : 0 < s) : Gamma s = ∫ x in Ioi 0, e^{-x} x^{s-1} (forward rw, since Gamma is on the RHS of the calc step).
